name: Perception
tagline: Every wire visible. Every sample earned.
description: Perception is a transparent modular digital audio workstation: timeline, signal-flow patch bay, and bus routing in one native studio.

views.label: Timeline
views.caption: Arrangement & Piano Roll — 17 tracks, velocity lanes, and live track inspector.
views.alt: Perception Timeline view showing 17-track arrangement, piano roll with note velocities, and Track Inspector panel

views.label: Track patch
views.caption: Modular Signal Flow — Exciter, strike comb, waveguide string, loss filter, waveshaper, delay, and live oscilloscope.
views.alt: Perception Track Patch view showing connected DSP modules, glowing orange audio cables, and live oscilloscope

views.label: Bus routing
views.caption: Transparent Mix & Signal Flow — Every gain, pan, group bus, Space send, and compressor detector wired to Master.
views.alt: Perception Bus Routing view showing track routing table, orthogonal signal flow graph to Master, and Bus Inspector

gallery.title: Silt Relay — Undertow Bus
gallery.caption: Kick-keyed Undertow bus ducking the sub in Silt Relay (138 BPM, 18 bars).

gallery.title: Rivet Pulse — Three-Way Routing
gallery.caption: Dry path through Objects, 6% channel-swap tap into Undertow, and 19% Space send.

gallery.title: Glass Pins — Dual-Bus Lift
gallery.caption: FFT pitch shifter mixing a formant-preserved fifth at 22% wet into Pin bed and Objects.

gallery.title: Bus Outputs & Cycle Guard
gallery.caption: Feed any stereo group into another with automatic cycle detection that preserves valid routes.

gallery.title: Patch Sends Inspector
gallery.caption: Tap any internal module outlet straight into a stereo bus without disturbing the dry cable.

gallery.title: Direct Piano Roll Editing
gallery.caption: Drag notes in pitch and time with immediate beat, length, and velocity readouts.

instruments.summary: Full routed DSP graph built per note with pitch- and velocity-following parameters.

instruments.summary: Waveguide string excited by a single-period noise burst, naturally damped on release.
Bowed string model with gated bow velocity and fading 5.4 Hz vibrato.
Eight coupled modal resonators tuned to harmonic bell ratios from a single strike.
Eight bar-mode resonators struck once for marimba, vibraphone, and metallic percussion.
Dual detuned phase-distortion operators that bloom smoothly toward a pure sine.
instruments.controls: breakpoint, feedback, attack, release, bloom, detune (cents)

instruments.summary: Pitch-swept sine body layered with a coloured noise burst up to 1 second.
